regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Participating, Individual, Life Insurance Savings Plan
key_benefits: Modular plan: choose Income or Lump Sum or both, with a life cover throughout the policy term (up to age 100)
Income Benefit = Guaranteed Income plus Cash Bonus (if declared) — varies by option
Deferred Income: Guaranteed Income 4% of Benefit Sum Assured plus cash bonus, after PPT plus deferment
Early Income: income from 1st month/year after deferment (cash bonus if declared plus Guaranteed Income)
Increasing Income: Benefit Sum Assured grows 5% p.a. compounding; income is guaranteed plus cash bonus
Wealth: lump sum (Maturity Sum Assured) at end of policy term
Maturity Benefit includes Sum Assured on Maturity, accumulated income benefits, and Terminal Bonus (if declared)
Death Benefit: Sum Assured on Death (11x Annualised Premium) plus accumulated income plus Terminal Bonus (if declared); not less than Guaranteed Death Benefit
riders_available: Bajaj Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider
Bajaj Life New Waiver of Premium Rider
Bajaj Life New Critical Illness Benefit Rider
Bajaj Life Care Plus Rider Non-Linked

eligibility.policy_term: Up to age 100 (income payable up to 100 years of age depending on option)

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the Policy Document.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months from commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), the suicide-clause refund of eligible Regular Premiums / Surrender Value applies; no other benefit. Policy must be in force. (Standard 80%-of-premiums / surrender-value formulation; exact wording not fully captured from parse.)
key_terms.loan_note: Policy loan available up to 80% of [Surrender Value less Terminal Bonus on surrender less any Accumulated Income Benefit] plus 50% of Terminal Bonus on surrender. Current loan interest 9% p.a. compounded half-yearly.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits on premiums paid and benefits received 'as per prevailing tax laws'; GST and cess collected over and above premium.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a PARTICIPATING plan — Cash Bonus and Terminal Bonus are 'if declared' (non-guaranteed); any income/maturity figure that includes bonus must be clearly marked as not guaranteed.
Guaranteed Income is a fixed factor (e.g. 4%/6% of Benefit Sum Assured depending on option and policy term) and is separate from the non-guaranteed cash bonus.
Sum Assured on Death is fixed at 11 times Annualised Premium; death benefit is never less than the Guaranteed Death Benefit.
Benefit availability (income vs lump sum) depends on the chosen option (Deferred/Early/Increasing Income or Wealth) — claims must be option-qualified.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT present Cash Bonus or Terminal Bonus as guaranteed — they are payable only 'if declared' by the company; bonus rates must never be shown as assured.
Do NOT show total/illustrative returns that bundle bonuses without an explicit 'bonus if declared / not guaranteed' caveat.
Do NOT position as a market-linked / unit-linked product — it is non-linked (participating, traditional).
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'as per prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Participating, Individual, Life Insurance Savings Plan'
That cash bonus and terminal bonus are non-guaranteed ('if declared')
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, conditions and exclusions
